recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: universal agent harnesses reaching for any tool
bayesian calibration charts flickering on old screens
pong wars glowing on a commodore 64
clear summer morning over san francisco
fog burning off before an eight-thirty sunset

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap on stutter-house beat drops to snap between parallel fog lanes — each lane holds a different synth fragment you must chain before the loop resets.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one perfect 30-second stutter chain feels like nailing a drop live
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and beat windows shrink while lanes multiply

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick vinyl coasters across a yacht-deck pool table to collect drifting dream-pop notes — miss the pocket and they slide into the bay.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clear the deck before golden-hour sunset in under a minute
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind gusts curve trajectories and notes cluster farther apart

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one-finger paths through rolling Karl fog bands so tiny agents can reach harness nodes before the trail evaporates.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: route three agents to their nodes in a single satisfying minute
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: fog rolls back faster and nodes spawn behind thicker layers
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor SF skyline with translucent fog strata

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort belief chips into calibrated bins — drag probability tokens until your posterior matches hidden targets before the CRT flickers out.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: nail five calibrations in 45 seconds with a satisfying lock-in chime
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: overlapping categories tighten tolerance and bins shuffle mid-round
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: green phosphor commodore screen with pixel bayesian charts
